# CONSOLIDATA
Canonical: https://cdatats.com/
Language: English
Growth Clarity Assessment: USD99 one time plus applicable tax, disclosed before payment. The assessment is optional; the homepage offers a direct marketing discussion.
Audience: startup company owners, chief executives, product leads and marketing leaders in the United States and Canada. Businesses with a customer, product or marketing decision may discuss their needs; funding is not a service requirement.
Purpose: clarify who buys, in what situation, the problem, desired benefit, current alternative and buying-reason hypothesis; preserve reported growth observations, examine plausible explanations and choose one bounded evidence check. The report is useful independently of any later purchase.
Question structure: 30 questions, comprising six starting questions and six groups of four. Groups cover reach, customer response, first useful result, purchase, continued use and evidence. Unknown and deferred answers remain visible.
Method: after server-verified payment, the explicitly configured OpenAI or Anthropic service interprets all 30 answers and optional notes to prepare an artificial intelligence assisted initial analysis. The configured provider is named before purchase; provider selection is explicit, with no automatic provider fallback. Code copies cited quotations directly from saved answers and notes. Quotations establish text provenance, not the truth of the account or a causal diagnosis. No underlying records are independently audited and no human advisory review is included.
Four customer-value questions: desired result, credible basis for believing it can be achieved, waiting time and customer effort or sacrifice. Actual delivery, exposure, costs and business results require separate evidence.
Entry: https://cdatats.com/growth-assessment.html — noindex questionnaire, answer review and submission acknowledgment, limited coverage preview, work-email save and confirmation, separate US$99 purchase review, then secure hosted payment when available.
Delivery: complete private report as a portable document format (PDF) email attachment after verified payment. No public full-report display, download or export endpoint. The report includes context, provisional ranked hypotheses where the information supports a comparison, credible alternatives, source-linked quotations, contradictions and unknowns, four customer-value questions, one proposed discriminating next check and the complete answer record. Insufficient information may produce an evidence-gathering plan without a ranked explanation.
Availability: /api/checkup/config controls configured checkout readiness; each saved assessment also requires explicit server-confirmed purchase eligibility. All unknown or deferred answers with no substantive notes cannot open checkout; one concrete product, customer or decision fact can be added while other answers remain unknown. These are purchase rules, not a claim that providers or checkout are currently available. Starting or saving work email creates no charge and no marketing subscription.
Privacy: unsubmitted answers remain in page memory; confirmed answers and separately saved email are stored privately on the server. The delivery email, payment details and opaque assessment reference are excluded from the analysis input. OpenAI requests use store: false; Anthropic requests use its Messages API without that OpenAI setting. Applicable provider retention is explained in the privacy notice. Only an opaque assessment reference is kept in browser session storage. Returning from checkout never proves payment. Payment verification, email processing and email-service acceptance remain separate; service acceptance does not prove inbox arrival.
Limits: initial unverified hypotheses are not a causal diagnosis. No certified single cause, measured outcome probability, guaranteed growth, revenue or profit. ConsoliData research, positioning, offer, content, outreach and measurement services may help where the evidence supports them. Product, continued-use, operations or financial issues may need another owner. Further research and implementation require a separate written scope and commercial agreement. No campaign or further service starts automatically.
Terms: https://cdatats.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://cdatats.com/privacy.html
Contact: alvinj@consolidatats.com

Services: https://cdatats.com/services.html — customer research, message and channel testing, content and ongoing support are scoped and quoted to the customer's actual needs. Media spending, recruitment and participant incentives are separate; included work is never billed twice.
Research design: define the business decision, relevant customer groups, recruitment, counterevidence, required evidence and sufficiency review before work. Consider successful, struggling, departed and non-buying customers where relevant; a fixed count alone does not establish sufficiency or population coverage. Scope, extension costs and timing depend on the actual decision and access.
Testing design: agree a bounded comparison matrix across messages, formats or channels; stage a main contrast per wave or use a justified structured design. Audience differences between channels limit causal comparisons. Budgets, observation periods, further waves and stopping conditions are agreed explicitly.
First enterprise validation: no prepaid service fee. Agree scope, required inputs, period, evidence, acceptance standard, amount and payment date in writing before work. Payment follows agreed acceptance. A valid validation missing its standard has no fee for that validation. Insufficiency, unmet prerequisites and additional rounds are separately agreed. This is separate from the paid USD99 assessment.
Marketing discussion: https://cdatats.com/book.html (assessment is not required) opens the existing Google appointment scheduler for a twenty-minute ConsoliData conversation. The visitor chooses an available time and completes scheduler confirmation. Opening the page alone does not book a meeting. No report, answers or assessment reference is automatically passed in the link; further services are separately agreed.
Fictional sample: https://cdatats.com/sample-report.html — clearly labelled illustration of the report structure, not a real customer case or result.

Brand: CONSOLIDATA / ConsoliData Tech to Services Ltd. Tagline: Understand customers. Make more money. Company identity: https://www.linkedin.com/company/consolidata-tech-to-services/. The original member-facing image is available at https://cdatats.com/assets/brand/consolidata-linkedin-logo.jpg. The website crops its bars for a horizontal lockup and displays the current tagline as text.
Earlier purchases: historical orders keep their original scope, price and delivery terms; see https://cdatats.com/legacy47/terms.html . The new assessment is separate and does not require earlier buyers to repurchase.
